Welcome to the E2E Test Blog

January 15, 2024 by Test Author 1 min read

Welcome to the E2E Test Blog

This blog is used for end-to-end testing of the Mono-One theme.

Purpose

We test the following features:

  • Copy button positioning
  • Line numbers display
  • Dark mode toggle
  • Syntax highlighting
  • Responsive design

Simple Code Example

Here's a basic JavaScript function:

function greet(name) {
  console.log(`Hello, ${name}!`);
  return `Greeting sent to ${name}`;
}

const result = greet("World");
console.log(result);

Multiple Code Blocks

First block:

npm install
npm test
npm run build

Second block:

{
  "name": "test-project",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "scripts": {
    "test": "jest"
  }
}

That's it for the welcome post!
